## Infra / secrets
- GitHub: `argent-gnome/sdlc-skills` (Pages site builds from `main`). Installed via `install.sh` (symlink mode) → `~/.claude/skills/`. Current VERSION: 0.5.0 (skills bundle; unchanged by S1 — the CLI versions separately at `cli/package.json` 0.1.0).
- **Six skills now, two coexisting sets** ([ADR-0004](adr/0004-house2-coexistence-and-advisory-hooks.md)): v1 — `house-shaper` · `house-orchestrator` · `house-builder` — unchanged and untouched; v2 — `house2-shaper` · `house2-orchestrator` · `house2-builder` — new in S2 Unit 2, require a repo `house init` has run in (`.house/` present; mutual-refusal preflight sends v1 work to v1 and v2 work to v2). Both sets install via the same `./install.sh` (it globs `skills/*/`).
- Runtime doctrine, **two files during the S2→S3 coexistence window:** v1 at `skills/house-orchestrator/references/doctrine.md` (cited by the v1 skills via `$HOME/.claude/skills/house-orchestrator/...`); v2 at `skills/house2-orchestrator/references/doctrine.md` (cited by the v2 skills via `$HOME/.claude/skills/house2-orchestrator/...`), read on-demand only, never preloaded. S3 cutover retires the v1 file along with the v1 skills.
- **`house` CLI:** lives in `cli/`; **`./install.sh` now installs it** (npm install in `cli/` + `npm link`, falling back to a symlink in `~/.local/bin` if the global prefix is not writable) alongside the skill symlinks — S2 Unit 1. Tests: `cd cli && npm test`. Usage: `cli/README.md`.
- **Advisory hooks are live in this repo:** `house init` merged a house block into `.claude/settings.json` (`SessionStart`/`SessionEnd`/`PreToolUse`/`SubagentStop` → `house hook …`). Advisory-only by [ADR-0004](adr/0004-house2-coexistence-and-advisory-hooks.md) — they never block, never exit non-zero, and record `hook.degraded` when they swallow an error. Merged, never overwritten: hand-added hooks survive `house init`.
- **No hosted CI — by decision** ([`docs/adr/0003-no-hosted-ci-local-verification.md`](adr/0003-no-hosted-ci-local-verification.md)). There is no `.github/workflows` and none is to be added. The verification bar is local and unchanged in rigor: `cd cli && npm test` green **+** `house validate` exit 0 — run by the builder, then **independently re-run by the merge-gate reviewer** (never trust the builder's report). Stage-8 "CI green" is permanently n/a here.
- **GitHub repo settings:** auto-delete-head-branch is **ENABLED** on `argent-gnome/sdlc-skills` (the doctrine's repo-setup item is done) — merged PR branches are pruned by GitHub; the local branch + worktree are still yours to remove.

## Gotchas
- `docs/*.html` are **hand-authored** (no generator) — mirror any `docs/*.md` prose change into the matching `.html` by hand.
- `install.sh` symlinks each `skills/<name>` → editing the repo file IS the live skill (run `/reload-skills` to pick up changes).
- Squash-merging a PR breaks `git branch --merged` detection — confirm merged-ness via PR state before pruning (now codified in the doctrine).
- The five sections at the top of this file are **generated** — hand-edits there are overwritten by the next `house render dev-state`. Write below the `<!-- house:manual -->` marker; the renderer parses positionally (title | generated | manual | tail) and refuses (exit 1, nothing written) on *any* content outside those regions, naming the first offender. Fix the file, then re-render — there is no back-compat path.
- `.house/index.json` is a rebuildable cache and is gitignored — never hand-edit it; run `house index`.
- **Kernel-owned files are CLI-written, not hand-edited:** `slice.yaml` fields, `gates/*.yaml`, `tasks.yaml` ticks, `units/NN-report.md`, `.house/events.jsonl`. Use the matching command (`house state/gate/task/block/unblock/artifact/unit/pr`) — each writes its own event, which is the whole one-writer-per-field invariant. The `PreToolUse` hook will *ask* before an Edit/Write to those paths; that prompt is the reminder, not a bug.
